meta.name: x-search
meta.description: MUST read before searching X/Twitter with the x_search tool. When xAI is connected: date-bound every time-sensitive query (from_date >= yesterday, widen to 7 days), scope trusted accounts with allowed_x_handles, phrase queries as latest/recent with since:/from:/filter: operators, split into 2-3 searches by account and by keyword, and reconcile against web_search. Triggers: X search, Twitter search, tweets, posts on X, what people are saying on X, x_search, social signal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定最新日期与可信账号，精准搜出X上的相关推文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在X上搜索话题，并希望只看最新、来自可信账号的说法。
copy.tagline_en: Find the latest, trustworthy X posts using date and trusted-account filters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you search X for topics and want up-to-date, credible takes from trusted accounts.

howto.what: Claude 会用 x_search 搜 X（Twitter）：查询绑定日期、限定可信账号，拆成按账号和按关键词的 2-3 次搜索，再与网页搜索对照。引用附 x.com 链接，并注明帖子来自某账号、非已核实事实。
howto.when: 当你提到 X 搜索、Twitter 搜索、推文等关键词，或想知道大家在 X 上怎么说时触发；需要已连接 xAI 账号，否则它会说明工具不可用并改用网页搜索。

say.text: 搜一下最近一天 X 上关于 NVDA 的帖子
say.note: 会绑定日期、去掉回复噪声并拆成多次搜索

say.text: 只看我信任的这几个账号发的推文：growth_papa
say.note: 把这些账号作为 allowed_x_handles 限定范围

say.text: 这个话题 X 上有讨论吗？顺便和网页搜索对一下
say.note: 两边结果不一致时会分别说明

howto.what_en: Claude uses x_search to search X (Twitter): queries are date-bounded, scoped to trusted handles, and split into 2-3 searches by account and keyword, then reconciled with web_search. It cites x.com URLs and flags posts as unverified.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention X search, Twitter search, or tweets, or ask what people are saying on X. If no xAI account is connected, it reports x_search unavailable and uses web_search.

say_en.text: Search X for posts about NVDA from the last day
say_en.note: Date-bounds the query and splits the search

say_en.text: Only look at posts from these handles: growth_papa
Is this being discussed on X? Check the web too
